notes.title: EPISODE ONE OVERHAUL IS OUT
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey guys, Aqua here![/b][/h1]

Back in January, I posted here that a major update was being prepared for the game. So I didn't lie!

After the release of the game, I collected a lot of useful feedback about the episode, after which all this feedback was implemented into the game!

My brother became interested in this game, and decided to help me with the scenario part of the game. After much discussion, we realized that the current plot in the game needs to be changed. And so it turned out. The first episode now has a slightly different meaning than it had before, so don't be surprised by the changes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398066/560767e2725f38c0299b7ea32bd0d0d850498e90.png[/img]

The game's trailer has also been updated, please check it out!

I'm not sure if the first episode is going to see any major changes other than bugfixes. That's why the two of us are going to work on the second episode (we've already come up with a lot of interesting stuff)

[b]Aqua[/b]

notes.title: Release date for EP. 1!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hi everyone, aqua here![/b][/h1]

After long wait for approval, and some resubmitting, the steam page is finally out!

I can't put into words on how I'm happy on this accomplishment. I've been developing some small indie games scince I was 11 or 12, and now I'm finally releasing my first small project on Steam.

First Episode of this story is called 'NOT MYSELF ANYMORE' and it will be realising on [b]January 21st[/b].

Please keep in mind that this is my first semi-big project, and I was working on it alone for half a year now. The first episode is small, but it's a start to this story I'm working on, and I'm already working on the second one. Second episode will feature a lot more story and will be a lot bigger than the first one. 

But enough of the future, let's focus on what's happening now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398066/e2cc93aba26ecbc89d75cd900181eb329065b06a.png[/img]

First episode is gonna cost around 2$, so I sincerely thank you if you decide to purchase a copy for yourself. 

Of course this game is [b]heavily inspired[/b] by Bendy franchise, which I was a big fan of when I was younger. So with that inspiration, this project came to life.

In conclusion, I'm insanely happy to do all of this, and thank you if you decide to show some interest about this project. 

But for now, I'm gonna go and prepare the game for release. See you next time ^_^

[b]Aqua[/b]
